'''Lachichuk''' was a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Force Collection" /> [[Wookiee]] [[Wookiee warrior|Warrior]] who fought alongside the [[Galactic Republic]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the latter's attempt to [[Battle of Kashyyyk|invade]] the Wookiee [[species]]' [[homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> He had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lachichuk first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWYBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The Wookiee had been previously named in the in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]] and released on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The name was confirmed to be [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'', which was initially released in [[2013]].<ref name="Force Collection" />
